marks.gloss_en: תא שמע, R' Oshaya and R' Chiyya taught: 'do not return' / 'do not finish' -- included in forty lashes per R' Yehuda; שמע מינה he flogs for a prohibition converted to a positive command (141b.3)
the baraita of R' Oshaya and R' Chiyya: 'do not return' and he returned, 'do not finish' and he finished -- included in forty lashes, the words of R' Yehuda
דלמא התם היינו טעם, דקסבר 'תעזוב' מעיקרא משמע -- there his reason may be that 'you shall leave' means from the outset
תא שמע: R' Yehuda holds no lashes for leftover sacrificial meat, the positive command following the prohibition -- שמע מינה his reason in the mishna is 'shaleach' from the outset. שמע מינה.
the baraita: 'leave nothing of it until morning... burn in fire' -- the verse gives a positive command after the prohibition to tell you one is not flogged for it, the words of R' Yehuda
מתניתין נמי דייקא: 'flogged and does NOT send' -- were his reason that one is flogged for a prohibition converted to a positive command, it should say 'flogged and sends'
ודלמא הכי קאמר: אין נפטר עד דמלקין ליה -- perhaps the mishna means he is not exempt until he is flogged
והשתא דאמר רב יהודה אמר רב אסור לזכות בביצים שהאם רובצת עליהן -- since he cannot acquire them himself, his courtyard does not acquire them for him either
Rav: one may not acquire eggs on which the mother is resting
כמאן? if per R' Yehuda -- flogged and does not send [yet he had him send]; if per the Rabbis -- sends and is not flogged [yet he flogged]
לעולם כרבנן, ומכת מרדות מדרבנן (= p_maaseh_kerabanan, p_malkut_makat_mardut)
actually [Rav Yehuda acted] according to the Rabbis
ולחוש לחשדא? -- should Rava not be concerned about suspicion?
כלאחר יד -- it was done in an unusual manner
he sent it, and Rava surrounded it with nets and caught it
ואי איתא להא דרבי יוסי בר רבי חנינא, חצרו של אדם קונה לו שלא מדעתו -- קרי כאן 'כי יקרא', פרט למזומן
R' Yosei bar R' Chanina: a man's courtyard acquires for him without his knowledge
Rabba: sending is obligated from the emergence of the egg's majority, acquisition only once it falls into the courtyard; the baraita speaks of before it falls (= p_rabba_okimta)
Rabba: an egg -- it is with the emergence of its majority that [one] becomes obligated in sending
אי הכי, אמאי אסורות משום גזל? -- if the eggs are not yet his, how is taking them robbery?
אאמם -- the clause is about the mothers (= p_gezel_aimam)
ואיבעית אימא: about the egg -- once its majority emerged his mind is on it (= p_gezel_daatei_alei)
[the robbery clause is] about their mothers
אי הכי, אמאי אסורות מפני דרכי שלום? אי דשלחה -- גזל מעליא הוא, אי דלא שלחה -- שלוחי בעי!
בקטן -- a minor took them (= p_bekatan)
קטן בר דרכי שלום הוא? -- is a minor subject to the ways of peace?
הכי קאמר: אביו של קטן חייב להחזיר לו מפני דרכי שלום (= p_aviv_shel_katan)
[the 'ways of peace' clause is] about a minor
למאי? אי למקנא -- לקנינהו ליה בסודר! אי ביום טוב -- בעומד ואומר 'זה וזה אני נוטל' סגיא!
R' Yehuda holds no lashes for a prohibition followed by a positive command (leftover meat), so that cannot be his reason for lashes here
how far does he send it? Rav Yehuda: enough that it leaves his hand
a man clipped its wings, sent it and afterwards caught it -- Rav Yehuda had him flogged
the man: the teima [bird] -- what is it [as to sending]?
the baraita: dovecote pigeons and attic pigeons are obligated in sending
Levi bar Simon transferred the produce of his dovecote to Rav Yehuda
